from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper from the provided collection, including which other provided papers it cites."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that this paper references in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
